title: 体温状态检查
problem_statement_md:
编写一个程序，以摄氏度为单位输入体温。

如果它在36.1到36.9的范围内(`>=36.1`且`<=36.9`)，打印 "OK"，否则打印 "Not OK"。
problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Int, double, float[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

Write a program that takes body temperature in Celsius as input.
If it is in range from 36.1 to 36.9 print "OK", otherwise print “Not OK”.

[b]Sample Input[/b]
37.2

[b]Sample Output[/b]
Not OK

[note]Temperature should be provided as a floating point number.[/note]
hint_md: 温度应该以浮点数的形式提供。
